cases.description: Unsectioned timeline with bare period entries and multiple events attached to a period.
cases.source:
~~~mermaid
timeline
title Bare periods
2001
: first event
: second event
2005
: closing event
~~~

cases.description: Title, multiple named sections, multiple periods, and events across sections.
cases.source:
~~~mermaid
timeline
title Sections and events
section Foundation
2001 : founded
2004 : first release
section Growth
2012 : expansion
: new market
2020 : new platform
~~~

cases.description: Empty section followed by a populated section, to capture whether empty sections still get a node and affect layout.
cases.source:
~~~mermaid
timeline
title Empty section
section Empty chapter
section Populated chapter
2024 : launch
~~~

cases.description: Explicit br label plus long event text to capture SVG tspan wrapping and text measurement.
cases.source:
~~~mermaid timeline title Wrapped labels section Labels 2023 : First line
second line : A long event label that must wrap inside the fixed timeline event node width ~~~

cases.description: Several colon-prefixed continuation event rows attached to the immediately preceding period.
cases.source:
~~~mermaid
timeline
section Continuing
2019
: first event
: second event with detail
: final event
~~~

cases.description: Accessible title and description directives alongside an ordinary diagram title and content.
cases.source:
~~~mermaid
timeline
title Accessibility metadata
accTitle: Timeline of releases
accDescr: A sequence of software milestones from first release to stable release.
section Releases
1.0 : first release
2.0 : stable release
~~~

cases.description: Explicit TD header selecting Mermaid's vertical timeline renderer.
cases.source:
~~~mermaid
timeline TD
title Vertical timeline
section Milestones
2018 : project begins
2020 : first deployment
: expanded rollout
2024 : current version
~~~

cases.description: In LR layout, a wrapped long period is followed by a short period in the same section and another short period in a new section, probing local height propagation and reset.
cases.source:
~~~mermaid
timeline
title Local period heights LR
section First group
A very long period label that wraps across multiple lines to enlarge its timeline node
: Long-period event
2024
: Short-period event
section Following group
2025
: Next-section event
~~~
